title: NGR-modified cancer-associated fibroblast-derived exosomes deliver resveratrol to inhibit CXCR2/NF-kappaB signaling in myeloid-derived suppressor cells and reverse immune suppression in liver cancer.
authors: Ding, Lijuan; Wang, Qiang; Wang, Xue; Fu, Weijia; Deng, Chen; Wang, Shudong
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用NGR修饰的CAF外泌体递送白藜芦醇靶向MDSCs抑制CXCR2/NF-kB通路，属于肿瘤免疫治疗与药物递送研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to develop NGR (Asn-Gly-Arg) peptide-modified cancer-associated fibroblast (CAF)-derived exosomes for resveratrol delivery (NGR-Exos@Res) to target myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) in the tumor microenvironment. By inhibiting the CXCR2/NF-kappaB pathway, this strategy reprograms MDSC function, reverses immune suppression, restores CD8(+) T-cell antitumor activity, and suppresses liver cancer (LC) progression. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified CXCR2 as a key Res target. Public scRNA-seq data analyzed MDSC-T-cell interactions in LC. Bone marrow-derived MDSCs were treated with Res in vitro; effects on CXCR2/immunosuppressive molecules were assessed via Western blot/immunofluorescence. A CAF line expressing 3xHis-NGR-CD63 was generated to produce NGR-Exos loaded with Res (NGR-Exos@Res). Their toxicity, uptake, and biodistribution were evaluated. Efficacy was tested in a murine LC xenograft model, assessing MDSC function, T-cell activation, and immune evasion. RESULTS: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis revealed that CXCR2 was highly expressed in MDSCs within HCC tissues. Moreover, inhibitory ligand-receptor pairs such as MIF-(CD74(+)CXCR4) were significantly activated in the interaction network between MDSCs and T cells. In vitro experiments demonstrated that resveratrol markedly downregulated the expression of CXCR2, Arg-1, and iNOS in MDSCs, thereby suppressing their proliferation while enhancing CD8(+) T-cell proliferation and IFN-gamma secretion. The successfully constructed NGR-Exos@Res drug delivery system exhibited a drug encapsulation efficiency of 19.3% and improved serum stability. In vivo, treatment with NGR-Exos@Res significantly reduced tumor volume, inhibited the CXCR2/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, decreased the proportion of MDSCs, and enhanced CD8(+) T-cell activity. CONCLUSION: In this study, we successfully constructed NGR peptide-modified Exos derived from CAFs for the targeted delivery of Res. This work innovatively proposes a novel immunotherapeutic strategy that targets tumor-associated MDSCs rather than directly killing tumor cells. Mechanistically, we identify and validate CXCR2 as a previously unrecognized functional target of resveratrol in MDSCs, through which resveratrol suppresses NF-kappaB signaling and reprograms MDSC function. Collectively, NGR-Exos@Res represents a precise and efficient delivery platform capable of reversing the immunosuppressive microenvironment in LC and provides a promising combinatorial strategy to overcome immunotherapy resistance by targeting immunosuppressive myeloid cells.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在开发NGR（Asn-Gly-Arg）肽修饰的癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAF）来源外泌体，用于递送白藜芦醇（NGR-Exos@Res），以靶向肿瘤微环境中的髓源性抑制细胞（MDSCs）。通过抑制CXCR2/NF-kappaB通路，该策略重编程MDSC功能，逆转免疫抑制，恢复CD8(+) T细胞抗肿瘤活性，并抑制肝癌（LC）进展。方法：网络药理学和分子对接确定CXCR2为Res的关键靶点。公共scRNA-seq数据分析LC中MDSC-T细胞相互作用。体外用Res处理骨髓来源的MDSCs；通过Western blot/免疫荧光评估对CXCR2/免疫抑制分子的影响。生成表达3xHis-NGR-CD63的CAF细胞系，以产生负载Res的NGR-Exos（NGR-Exos@Res）。评估其毒性、摄取和生物分布。在小鼠LC异种移植模型中测试疗效，评估MDSC功能、T细胞活化和免疫逃逸。结果：单细胞转录组分析显示，CXCR2在HCC组织中的MDSCs内高表达。此外，抑制性配体-受体对如MIF-(CD74(+)CXCR4)在MDSCs与T细胞的相互作用网络中显著激活。体外实验表明，白藜芦醇显著下调MDSCs中CXCR2、Arg-1和iNOS的表达，从而抑制其增殖，同时增强CD8(+) T细胞增殖和IFN-gamma分泌。成功构建的NGR-Exos@Res药物递送系统表现出19.3%的药物包封效率，并改善了血清稳定性。在体内，NGR-Exos@Res治疗显著减少肿瘤体积，抑制CXCR2/NF-kappaB信号通路，降低MDSCs比例，并增强CD8(+) T细胞活性。结论：在本研究中，我们成功构建了源自CAFs的NGR肽修饰外泌体，用于Res的靶向递送。这项工作创新性地提出了一种新的免疫治疗策略，该策略靶向肿瘤相关MDSCs而非直接杀伤肿瘤细胞。在机制上，我们识别并验证CXCR2是白藜芦醇在MDSCs中先前未被认识的功能靶点，通过该靶点，白藜芦醇抑制NF-kappaB信号并重编程MDSC功能。总体而言，NGR-Exos@Res代表了一种精确高效的递送平台，能够逆转LC中的免疫抑制微环境，并提供了一种有前景的组合策略，通过靶向免疫抑制性髓系细胞来克服免疫治疗耐药性。
